name: What happens after a roof penetration assessment?

mainEntity.name: What happens after a roof penetration assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: After a roof penetration assessment, our team will provide you with a detailed report outlining any identified issues, complete with photographic evidence. We will then discuss the findings with you and provide a clear, itemized proposal for any necessary repairs or maintenance. You will receive transparent options and recommendations without obligation, allowing you to make an informed decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: You receive a detailed report with photos, followed by a discussion of findings and a proposal for necessary repairs.
